name: Cesare Borgia
contribution: An Italian-Spanish cardinal deacon and condottiero from the House of Borgia.
legacy: His quest for political power was a major inspiration for The Prince by the renowned Florentine historian, Niccolò Machiavelli.

checks.lead: Cesare Borgia (13 September 1475 – 12 March 1507) was an Italian-Spanish cardinal deacon and condottiero from the House of Borgia. He was the illegitimate son of Pope Alexander VI and sibling to Lucrezia Borgia.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
